items.title: McNeal Breaux Interview, 1958-11-24
items.q: I'm playing with Lawrence Morell, the Dixieland band.

ctx.x: Well, I can't think of any other questions. Anything you'd like to add? Anything about your life? You think we might have forgotten? Otherwise, we're just about at the end.
Oh, no, it's just about all of them. I'm playing with Lawrence Morell, the Dixieland band. All we need is some customers. We've got the band.
Yeah, that's right. It's a good band. We're trying to line that up, we hope.
